name: Senkawa Yuuki
source:
A 2nd year high school student. She's a girl from the city who met Chikako at a guesthouse. She likes space engineering and astronomy, so she came to the village for free research. She's a genius who acts as the group's brain.

[Translated from [url=https://ahonojuge00.wixsite.com/rinjou-stargazer]official website[/url]]
